text:
Oliver: Big news  I promised I'd tell you all when it was official We're expecting twins in September!! 🍼🍼 Little overwhelmed but super excited. Wanted to share and plan a mini send-off / baby shower before my leave.

Zoe: OMG congrats Oliver!!! 🎉🎉 Twins!! You're going to be a legend. When were you thinking for the shower?

Oliver: Thanks Zoe!! Maybe mid-August during team retro week? Could be afternoon, cake + non-alcoholic drinks. Open to suggestions.

Priya: Congrats!! I can organize decorations and a diaper raffle (low effort). Also happy to start a sign-up list for meals while you're on paternity.

Mae: Love this. I'll bring a playlist and a onesie-painting kit. Also can help with meal train scheduling.

Raja: Congrats, man. I'll take desserts and handle an insulated meal drop-off week 1.

Kiran: Count me in. Will bring savory finger foods. Also tagging PeopleOps for parental-leave coordination and to confirm remote days policy.

PeopleOps-Bot: PeopleOps-Bot: Congrats message received. Parental leave resources: https://intranet.redwood/hr/parental-leave. Reminder: submit leave request at least 6 weeks before start date for paperwork. PeopleOps will reach out to coordinate a short 1:1.

Oliver: Appreciate it  Thank you everyone. For the sign-up: reply with what you'll bring + whether you can drop off a meal (yes/no). Trying to keep it casual and low stress.

Priya: Diaper raffle + packing list: I'll make a simple Google Sheet and paste link here tomorrow. Bringing veggie samosas (drop-off week 1: yes).

Mae: Onesie kit + playlist. Meal drop-off: maybe week 2 (yes).

Raja: Lemon bars + meal drop-off week 1: yes.

Kiran: Savory skewers, no meal drop-off (we travel that week) but happy to help prep.

Zoe: I'll make a tiny cake and bring party napkins. Drop-off week 1: yes.

Oliver: This is wonderful  Thank you all. I'll send a calendar invite for an August 15th 3:30pm courtyard meetup (tentative) and update once PeopleOps confirms paperwork dates. Really grateful
